skill.name: orca-cli
skill.description: Use the `h0x` CLI to operate h0x-ADE-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing, worktree comments, and h0x-ADE's embedded browser. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "use h0x cli", "h0x-ADE worktree", "child worktree", "cardStatus", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send h0x-ADE terminal", "terminal send", "full handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree", "h0x-ADE browser", "h0x artifacts", "share HTML/Markdown", "public artifact link", "share skills", or "control the browser inside h0x-ADE". Prefer this over raw `git worktree`, ad hoc PTYs, Playwright, or Computer Use when the task touches h0x-ADE-managed state. Use Computer Use for external browser windows, webviews, or desktop UI only when the task requires OS/window-level control such as focus, menus, dialogs, coordinates, or screenshots. Use `orca-cli` for h0x-ADE's embedded pages and a page-automation tool such as Playwright or CDP for external pages.

security_audit.summary: All 22 static findings are false positives. The analyzer matched Markdown inline-code and fenced-command formatting, including textual PowerShell and cmd.exe references, rather than executable code. No prompt injection or other net-new semantic security finding was identified in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: The skill guides agents to run an external h0x or orca executable, which can change worktrees, terminals, repositories, and automations.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before mutating operations, validate the resolved executable, and keep read-only inspection commands separate from state-changing commands.

remediation.issue: ORCA_CLI_COMMAND is accepted as the executable override.
remediation.suggestion: Treat the environment value as trusted configuration only, display the resolved executable before use, and reject empty or unexpected executable paths.

content.value_statement: Agents need reliable access to h0x-ADE state without guessing the correct executable or command version. This skill resolves the session CLI, loads its matching guide, and supports managed worktree, terminal, repository, automation, artifact, handoff, and browser workflows.
actual_capabilities: Selects the session executable using ORCA_CLI_COMMAND, ORCA_DEV_REPO_ROOT, and platform context.
Loads the version-matched CLI guide before running h0x commands.
Supports managed worktree, folder context, terminal, repository, automation, and comment workflows.
Supports artifact sharing, skill sharing, agent handoffs, and h0x-ADE embedded browser workflows.
Provides bounded, read-only bootstrap commands for older binaries without the skills get command.
limitations: The skill requires an available h0x, h0x-dev, or orca executable in the current session.
The full command reference comes from the selected binary and can vary across h0x-ADE versions.
The skill does not control external browser windows or desktop interfaces.
Mutating operations can affect worktrees, terminals, repositories, or automations and require operational care.

use_cases.title: Manage Isolated Worktrees
use_cases.description: Create, inspect, and coordinate h0x-ADE worktrees while preserving the editor runtime as the source of truth.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Agent Handoffs
use_cases.description: Prepare full handoffs between agents and worktrees with consistent terminal and repository context.

use_cases.title: Operate Embedded Workflows
use_cases.description: Inspect terminals, share artifacts, manage skills, and automate pages inside the h0x-ADE application.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve the Session CLI
prompt_templates.prompt: Determine the correct h0x-ADE CLI executable for this session. Follow the documented environment and platform rules, then report the selected executable.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Managed State
prompt_templates.prompt: Load the full guide for the resolved CLI, then inspect the current application status, worktrees, and terminals. Use read-only commands and summarize the results.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Agent Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the version-matched guide to prepare a complete handoff for the selected child worktree. Include relevant repository, terminal, and worktree context.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Controlled Automation
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the resolved CLI and its current guide, perform the requested h0x-ADE automation or embedded-browser task. Confirm the target context, prefer structured output, and report every state-changing action.

output_examples.input: Identify the correct executable in a Linux session outside h0x-ADE.
output_examples.output: Selected h0x because no override or development checkout was available. Bare orca was avoided because it may start the GNOME screen reader.

best_practices: Resolve the executable once and reuse it for every command in the session.
Load the binary-provided guide before selecting subcommands or flags.
Confirm the target context and review state-changing actions before execution.
anti_patterns: Do not run bare orca on Linux outside an h0x-ADE-managed terminal.
Do not guess commands when the selected binary reports an unsupported subcommand.
Do not use this skill for external browser windows or desktop UI control.

faq.question: What does this skill control?
faq.answer: It controls h0x-ADE-managed worktrees, contexts, terminals, repositories, automations, artifacts, skills, handoffs, comments, and embedded browser pages.

faq.question: How is the executable selected?
faq.answer: The skill checks ORCA_CLI_COMMAND, then a development checkout, then Linux and managed-terminal context before choosing h0x or orca.

faq.question: Why load the guide first?
faq.answer: The h0x binary provides the version-matched reference, so agents can use the command surface supported by that exact binary.

faq.question: What happens with an older binary?
faq.answer: If skills get is explicitly unsupported, the skill permits a bounded read-only status, worktree, and terminal inspection flow.

faq.question: Can it control an external browser?
faq.answer: No. Use a page-automation tool for external pages and Computer Use for operating-system or window-level controls.

faq.question: Can commands change project state?
faq.answer: Yes. Worktree, terminal, repository, automation, and sharing operations can change state, so confirm the target and action before running them.
